coverage: Wasmtime resource controls and current stable release

findings.finding: WASI 0.3 is stable; most other toolchains still target 0.2.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Avoid coupling the MVP to immature language tooling.
findings.roadmap_delta: Start with versioned 0.2 command ABI; plan explicit 0.3 adapter.
findings.verification_needed: Compile and run real Rust wasip2 fixtures.

findings.finding: Wasmtime fuel is deterministic; epoch interruption needs a separately advancing engine epoch.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Host waits and compilation need additional limits.
findings.roadmap_delta: Fuel, store limits and async deadlines; external compilation limits documented.
findings.verification_needed: Fuel, memory, blocked wait and wall-time tests.

findings.finding: MCP stdio carries newline-delimited JSON-RPC and reserves stdout for protocol traffic.
findings.opportunity_or_risk: Protocol errors and tool errors have different semantics.
findings.roadmap_delta: Thin stdio adapter with bounded request framing.
findings.verification_needed: Lifecycle, tools/list, tools/call and malformed input tests.

overall_recommendation: Build a narrowly capability-secure deterministic profile, with independent tenant policy and reusable prepared components.
evidence_gaps: No independent security assessment or workload benchmark.
WASI 0.3 async conformance and SaaS network deployment deferred.
Research dispositions are advisory inputs to the authorized initial architecture.
